newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hesse to withdraw licence for RWE plant.
newsitem.headline: Hesse to withdraw licence for RWE plant.

text.p: The environment minister for the German state of Hesse, Margarethe Nimsch, said she planned to withdraw the operating licence for the nuclear plant Biblis A owned by German utility RWE AG.

Nimsch said that she had sent a 55-page letter to the German federal environment minister, Angela Merkel, detailing the technical security and legal status of the plant, and announcing a draft withdrawal of the plant's operating licence.

"It is no longer just a question of a temporary closure while the plant is upgraded, it is now a question of withdrawing the operating licence, because the plant cannot be upgraded in any reasonable timeframe," Nimsch said.
Earlier in October, a Frankfurt court refused damages to RWE, who had sued for 1.8 million marks ($1.2 million) damages after a three-day temporary closure of the plant.
